items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But was that your first recording with Thad Jones and Billy Mitchell? Yeah with Thad and Big Billy Mitchell, yeah.

ctx.x: Except the only place we couldn’t sing was at the dinner table. I remember Thad was singing that song called “Steamboat Bill” [Elvin imitates the song and sings the melody] “Steamboat Bill! Du du du da da da! Steamboat Bill” (laughs) and my father said to Thad “Shut up before I hit you in the head with this spoon” – BONG! (Elvin laughs). He rang like a gong! Oh boy.
So was Hank the first one of your brothers and sisters to become involved musically
